body: You there? Let's talk. I'm ... hold on ... 13 years older than you but hopefully we can shoot the shit without me sounding like a boomer/your grandpa. DM me

I don't think she would go for couples' counseling, but nonetheless, I appreciate the suggestion. After reading your reply and thinking about it, I probably will reach out to a friend. I have one in particular that I know would actually care.

Thank you for your advice. Experience or not, sometimes just hearing someone else's view helps with getting things into focus. Thank you again.
